finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug: flat coupons store the discount in USD, but `computeTotal` subtracted that raw USD number from the total after it had already converted to the target currency, so a `$10` discount became a `10 EUR` discount instead of `9 EUR`. Fixed in `src/services/pricing.js:9` by subtracting the flat coupon amount from the USD subtotal before converting, so the discount converts along with the rest of the order.
